Name: (WR) Example
Author: MGLXI
Description:
[size=6][b](WR) Example[/b][/size]

Example content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/YOUR_ID]Weapon Renderer[/url]. Overrides the attack sprite of 3 vanilla swords without changing their icons, names, or stats.

[b]This is a template.[/b] It is meant to be copied by modders who want to create their own Weapon Renderer content packs.

[line]

[size=5][b]What does this pack do?[/b][/size]

Replaces the attack sprite of the following vanilla weapons:

[list]
[*][b]Steel Smallsword[/b] (ID 11) — 24x24[/*]
[*][b]Lava Katana[/b] (ID 9) — 21x25[/*]
[*][b]Holy Blade[/b] (ID 3) — 23x23[/*]
[/list]
Inventory icons, names, stats, and shop listings [b]do not change[/b]. Only the sprite shown during the attack is replaced.

[line]

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0+.[/*]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/YOUR_ID]Weapon Renderer[/url].[/*]
[*]Extract this pack into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/font].[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]For modders[/b][/size]

This pack is a working example. You can copy its structure, rename the folders, replace the PNGs, and edit the [font=Courier New]weapon.json[/font] files to create your own content pack.

The full documentation (folder structure, every [font=Courier New]weapon.json[/font] field, pivot and hitbox formulas, override mode, translations, and public API) is included in the [b]README.md[/b] of Weapon Renderer.

[line]

[size=5][b]Structure[/b][/size]

[code]
(WR) Example/
├── manifest.json
├── README.md
└── weapons/
    ├── SteelSmallsword/
    │  ├── weapon_icon.json
    │  └── weapon_attack.png
    ├── LavaKatana/
    │  ├── weapon_icon.json
    │  └── weapon_attack.png
    └── HolyBlade/
        ├── weapon_icon.json
        └── weapon_attack.png[/code]
[line]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0+ — required[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/YOUR_ID]Weapon Renderer[/url] — required[/*]
[/list]
[line]
